items.text: Yesu naatwarwa omu maiso ga Pilaato
Nubwo ekitebe kyona eky'abantu kyaimukire, baatwara Yesu omumaiso ga Pilaato.
Baatandika kumunyegerra nibagamba bati: “Omuntu onu tumusangire naajemesa ihanga lyaitu, naatanga abantu kuha Kaisaali omusoro, kandi naayeyeta Kristo Omukama.”
Pilaato yamukaguza ati: “Niiwe Omukama w'Abayudaaya?” Yesu yagarukamu ati: “Nukwo ogambire.”
Pilaato yagaruka yagambira banyakatagara abakuru n'ekitebe kyona ati: “Omuntu onu timmuzoireho musango naakake.”
Baitu bbo baaterraho kimu amaani bati: “Naaleeta akajagarro omu bantu, akabandiza Galiraaya okuhika na hanu.”
Pilaato obu yahuliire ebigambo ebi, yabakaguza omusaija ogu obu araaba ali Mugaliraaya.
Obu yamanyire Yesu nkooku ali w'omu isaza lya Herode, yamumusindikira, habwokuba omu kasumi ako Herode nawe akaba ali omu Yerusaalemu.
Yesu ali omumaiso ga Herode
Herode obu yarozire Yesu, yasemererwa muno. Akaba amazire omwanya naayegomba kumurora, habwokuba akaba amuhuliireho kandi yanihiraga kumurora naakora ekyokuhuniriza.
Nikyo Herode yamaliire omwanya naamukaguza bingi; baitu Yesu atagarukemu kantu.
Baanyakatagara abakuru n'abeegesa b'ebiragiro baayemerra aho, nibamunyegerra ebintu bingi!
Herode n'abaserikale be baamwoleka emigayo nibamusekeereza. Herode yamujweka omwenagiro gw'ekitiinisa, yamugarra hali Pilaato.
Ha kiro eki kyonyini Herode na Pilato nubwo baganjaine, habwokuba kara koona bakaba banobangaine.
Pilaato naacwera Yesu omusango gw'okufa
Ebi obu byahoire, Pilaato yasorooza hamu banyakatagara abakuru, abalemi b'Abayudaaya n'abantu abandi,
yabagambira ati: “Mwandeetera omuntu onu nimugamba ngu, naajemesa abantu. Hati nyowe obu mmukagwize omu amaiso ganyu, timmuzoireho musango na gumu hali ebi byona ebi murukumujunaana.
Nangwa noobwakuba Herode tamuzoireho musango, nikyo amugaruliire hali itwe. Taina kintu kyona eki yakozire ekirukusemerra kumwisa.
Nahabweki ndaragira bamuteere enkoba, nukwo mmulekere agende.” [
Eki akakigamba habwokuba akaba naaragirwa kubalekerra omunyankomo omu ha kiro kikuru eki.]
Nubwo boona baatokiire hamu bati: “Ogu mwiheho, otulekerre Baraaba!”
Baraaba ogu akaba akwasirwe omu nkomo habw'okwemesa abantu ab'omu rubuga na habw'obwisi.
Pilato, habw'okugonza kulekera Yesu, akongera yababaliza;
baitu bbo baatoka bati: “Mubambe, mubambe ha musaraba!”
Pilaato yabakaguza omurundi gwa kasatu ati: “Habwaki? Kibi ki eki akozire? Timmuzoireho musango gwona ogusemeriire kumwisa! Nahabweki ndaragira bamuteere enkoba, nukwo mmulekere agende.”
Baitu baaterraho kimu amaani nibatokera haiguru, nibasaba ngu abambwe, kandi amaraka gaabo gaasingwire.
Pilaato nukwo kucwa omusango ngu, eki basabire nikyo kikorwe.
Yalekera omusaija ou bakomere, ogu ow'akaba akwasirwe omu nkomo habw'okwemesa abantu na habw'obwisi. Yahayo Yesu bamukole nkooku baagondeze.
Abakazi ba Yerusaalemu nibalirirra Yesu
Obu bakaba nibatwara Yesu, bakakwata omusaija arukwetwa Simooni owa Kireene, ow'akaba naaruga omu kyaro; baamutweka omusaraba aguhimbe, akuraatire Yesu.
Ekitebe kingi eky'abantu n'eky'abakazi abakaba nibarra, nibamuterra empamo, bakamuhondera.
Yesu yahinduka yabagambira ati: “Inywe bahara ba Yerusaalemu muleke kundirirra, baitu mweririrre inywenka kandi mulirirre abaana banyu.
Mumanye ebiro nibiija obu baligamba bati: ‘Baina omugisa abakazi engumba n'enda ezitakazaaraga, n'amabeere agatakonkyaga!’
Hos 10:8
Kus 6:16
Nubwo balitandika kutaagira ensozi bati: ‘Mutugwere!’ N'obusozi bati: ‘Mutuswekerre!’
Kinu obu baraaba nibakikora omuti gukyali mubisi, obu gulyoma balisura ki?”
Yesu naabambwa ha musaraba
Abandi ababiri, enkozi z'ebibi, bakatwarwa kwitwa hamu na Yesu.
Obu baahikire omu kiikaro ekirukwetwa: Oruhanga, oku nuho baamubambiire ha musaraba, hamu na bali babiri enkozi z'ebibi, omu ha rubaju rwe orw'obulyo, ondi ha rw'emoso.
Nubwo Yesu yasabiire abaamubambire naagamba ati: “Taata, obaganyire habwokuba tibarukumanya eki barukukora.” Baabagana ebijwaro bye, nibabiterra itomo.
Zab 22:7
Abantu bakeemerra aho nibasunga; n'abalemi baabo bakasekereza bati: “Akajuna abandi; obu araaba ali Kristo ayakomerwe Ruhanga, leka ayejune wenka!”
Abaserikale nabo bakamusekereza, baija baamuha amarwa agasaaliire,
nibagamba bati: “Obu oraaba oli omukama w'Abayudaaya, wejune wenka!”
Eruguru ye ha musaraba hakaba haroho ekihandiiko ekirukugamba kiti: “Onu nuwe Omukama w'Abayudaaya.”
Omu ha nkozi z'ebibi naayegarukamu
Omu ha nkozi z'ebibi abaabambirwe nawe akamuhera ati: “Tiniiwe Kristo? Wejune, na itwe otujune!”
Baitu mugenzi we yamuhana ati: “Torukutiina Ruhanga, kandi kunu ohairwe ekifubiro kimu nk'ekye?
Itwe gutusingirekwo, kandi twaheebwa ekifubiro ekitusemeriire habw'ebibi ebi twakozire; baitu onu taina eki yasobeze.”
Nubwo yagamba ati: “Yesu, onyijuke obu olihika omu bukama bwawe!”
Yesu yamugarukamu ati: “Mali mali ninkugambira nti: Kiro kya hati oraaba na nyowe omu nsi ey'Okuhirwa.”
Okufa kwa Yesu
Obu zikaba ziri saaha nka mukaaga, izooba lyaraara, omwirima gwasweka ensi egi yoona okuhika ha saaha mwenda.
Enyigamo y'omunju ya Ruhanga yatemukamu habiri.
Zab 31:5
Yesu yabaliza haiguru ati: “Taata, omwoyo gwange ngutaire omu mikono yawe!” Obu yamazire kugamba eki, yacwekana!
Omukuru w'abaserikale, obu yarozire ebibaireho, yakugiza Ruhanga naagamba ati: “Mazimakwo omuntu onu abaire muntu ahikiriire!”
Abantu boona abakaba beesoroliize aho kusunga, obu baarozire ebyabaireho, baagarukayo owaabubo nibahungya emitwe.
Luk 8:2
Abamanyi ba Yesu n'abakazi abakaba bamuhondiire kuruga Galiraaya, bakeemerra haraho baarora ebi byona.
Yesu naaziikwa
Hakaba haroho omusaija, ibara lye Yosefu, omukurasi omu Rukurato Orukuru, ayarugire omu rubuga Arimateya orwa Buyudaaya; akaba ali musaija murungi kandi ahikiriire,
ataikirranize n'ab'orukurato abandi ebi baategekere n'ebi baakozire. Uwe yaikaraga ategeriize obukama bwa Ruhanga.
Omusaija ogu akagenda hali Pilaato, yamusaba omutumbi gwa Yesu.
Hanyuma yaguhanuura ha musaraba, yaguzinga omu ngoye za bafuta ezirukwera, yaguta omu kituuro ekikaba kibaizirwe omu mwandara, ekitakaziikwamuga muntu.
Ekiro eki kikaba kiri eky'Okweteekaniza kandi Sabbato ekaba eri haihi kutandika.
Abakazi abakaba barugire Galiraaya hamu na Yesu, bakahondera Yosefu, baarora n'omutumbi gwa Yesu nkooku gwatairwemu.
Kurug 20:10
Bir 5:14
Baagarukayo omuka, baateekaniza ebirukuboya n'amagita agatabire, eby'okusiiga omutumbi.
Ha kiro kya Sabbato bakahuumura ekiragiro nkooku kyaragiraga.
